patterns.note: A persistent, thin orange horizontal line acts as a scroll progress indicator, moving down the left edge of the viewport as the user scrolls, providing a continuous visual anchor.
Content is presented in a single, narrow, centered column with generous horizontal white space, creating a focused, document-like reading experience reminiscent of a textbook.
A high-contrast palette of dark text on white backgrounds is consistently used, with a single bright orange accent color reserved for calls to action and the unique scroll indicator.
Complex concepts are broken down into distinct, visually separated sections, often featuring detailed diagrams and structured explanations, resembling an interactive manual or academic paper.

technique_notes: A video hero section is used at the top of the page to immediately convey the interactive and dynamic nature of the product, setting an engaging tone.
A fixed-position horizontal line on the left side of the viewport is animated to track the user's scroll progress, providing a continuous visual cue of depth on the page.
Key calls to action, like the 'Register Now' button, are implemented as sticky elements in the top right corner, remaining visible and accessible as the user scrolls down the extensive page.

design_tokens.type_scale: A balanced sans-serif type scale with clear hierarchy; headings are moderately larger and bolder than body text, maintaining readability without being overly dramatic.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp (elements like buttons and content blocks have minimal to no visible corner rounding).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (generous white space around content blocks and within sections, especially horizontally, creating a sense of calm and focused readability).

standout: The most distinctive design choice is the persistent, animated orange scroll indicator line on the left edge, which visually anchors the user's progress through the extensive, diagram-rich content. This, combined with the clean, almost academic layout, makes the site feel like an interactive, digital manual rather than a typical marketing page.
